baseline_v1.reason: 2026 is the holdout; v1 comparison not computed

limitations: nfl_pbp has no row-level publication/ingestion timestamp
historical schedule score revisions are not available in the current database

reference_pool_scope.kick_table: not filtered: the published kick rates include overtime kicks
reference_pool_scope.safety_kick_table: observed 2022-2025 regular-season safety free kicks, usable rows only

execution_verification.note: A layer is only reported executed when its instrumented decision path ran. State-conditional layers can have zero applications in a small sample; that remains visible and does not count as a silent fallback.

player_outcome_model.conditioning: event type plus joint yards-bin and touchdown label; result sampled before state transition
player_outcome_model.source: nflverse nfl_pbp pass, rush, sack, completion and interception fields; participant keys are GSIS ids
player_outcome_model.transfer_rule: outcome observations are retained by stable player id; QB decision tendencies are separately keyed by team and QB
player_outcome_model.yardage_fallback: a missing role-specific player yard field omits that result adjustment; emitted box-score yards use yards_gained when the source field is null

player_share_distribution.eligibility_rule: a rostered player listed Out or Doubtful on the frozen injury report is not eligible; Questionable and players with no report stay eligible; position-conditioned shares re-normalise within the selected eligible group

qb_decision_model.scramble_definition: qb_scramble among nflverse qb_dropback rows; scrambler identity uses rusher_player_id joined by GSIS id when its canonical position is QB
qb_decision_model.source: nfl_pbp qb_dropback, qb_scramble, pass_attempt, passer_player_id and rusher_player_id; canonical QB and receiver positions joined by GSIS id
qb_decision_model.transfer_rule: QB decision histories remain keyed by team and passer; a new team uses its team and league priors

player_projections.note: Means include zero production for nonparticipating games. Player results are role allocations from sampled historical plays, not player-specific performance projections.

receiver_position_usage.source: nfl_pbp player GSIS ID joined to players.nfl_gsis_id; position groups from canonical NFL identity

runner_position_usage.source: nfl_pbp player GSIS ID joined to players.nfl_gsis_id; position groups from canonical NFL identity

model_reference.play_pool: nfl_pbp seasons 2022-2025 only; no 2026 outcome is in the pool

pool_scope.kick_table: not filtered: the published kick rates include overtime kicks
pool_scope.safety_kick_table: observed 2022-2025 regular-season safety free kicks, usable rows only

simulation.regulation_score_policy: all runs whose simulation reached the regulation end, including ties and guarded regulation-end outcomes; descriptive, not validated finals
simulation.seed_rule: one deterministic game per consecutive non-negative integer seed
simulation.valid_score_policy: only valid_full_game=true, complete_game=true, untied outcomes; all other seeds remain in outcomes and coverage counts

configuration.overlap_rule: category A controls target-role label when available; playbook replaces C/D/E where supported

configuration.precedence: replaces decision labels for C/D/E when the source cell has a playbook prior
